notes: New: Recover Notes (tray menu). FileTag now keeps a tiny local backup of every note - if you delete one by mistake, you can get it back.
Fixed a bug where a deleted note could reappear if you reselected the file within a few seconds.
New What's New window - see what changed after every update (tray menu, and on the installer's finish screen).
Choosing Uninstall in Setup now simply uninstalls - it no longer chains into a reinstall.
Setup detects an existing install and updates it in place - no more duplicate installs.
Clean install folder (app, uninstaller, README, license) and a Start Menu shortcut.
Delete a note straight from the bar, with inline confirmation and 5 seconds to undo.
Translucency now shows real blur behind the panel.
Panel appearance settings: full bar or floating pill, background color, corner radius, size, font scale, optional blur.
Interactive first-run tutorial with a demo animation.
Notes can be attached to folders, not just files.
A small readme is placed at your cloud sync root so collaborators understand the .filetag files.
Setup and uninstall wizards, plus plain-text logs (tray menu, Open logs folder).
Settings window with live apply: position, accent color, auto-hide, animation, hotkey remap.
Notes sync across PCs via Google Drive and OneDrive folders, and work on any drive.
First release: notes on files via a hotkey and an overlay bar.
